summary: Base $38 -> $47.75 ($38 is the off-peak rate without water or showers); Mar 7-Dec 13; 30-amp; 46 sites; online via WebTrac, 365-day window; military cleared; tight for rigs over ~24 ft per campers.
flags: FIT (23-ft rule), needs a human look: the page's own caption reads '46 tent sites in the forest', and the booking site types sites Popup / Tent / Small Camper, with 'Large Camper' only on some (130 of seven sampled). No lengths posted. RV Life 2026 campers: 'Gravel lots, anything over 24ft would be a very tight fit' (site 138, rating 6); 'very limited space for larger rigs' (10/2026, rating 8); 32-ft trailer at site 107 'Tight fit for our slide out' (6/2026); 'only meant for tent campers' (6/2026, rating 4). A 23-ft rig seems to fit, narrowly on many sites.

LOCAL: public can book an ordinary night online. Rate gate: $47.75, under $50. Campers report $47 and one $55 (6/2026, probably with fees); no resident/non-resident split posted. Great Parks page live, 513-851-2267. RV Life 3.5*.
DISCOUNT: discounts.military (Good Sam directory, derived) cleared: operator pages don't state one. No camper reports one either.

SEASON from the campground's Hours table, whose dates are 2026's; rates are posted only from April 15, so March 7-April 14 has no posted rate. The table has a typo ('Aug. 2-Sept. 4' after 'May 23-Aug. 21').
WATER/SEWER unset: operator's pages list only 30-amp electric; campers report 'water no sewer no' and 'they are electric only'. A camper also says 'The dump station is on a hill and not well placed'.

Site scan partial: greatparks.org and WebTrac sit behind a bot wall, so seven of 45 site pages were read. Pin fine: at the campground entrance, the loop just west.
